row.requirement_and_acceptance: English URLs and their legacy redirects/rewrites shall resolve to the intended page, including mapped legacy clothing slugs.
row.qa_focus: Direct URL, encoded query, redirect destination

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Verified color options shall expose named swatches and applicable images; selected color accompanies cart line. Products under /demo-products/ shall hide colors and use one demo photograph.
row.qa_focus: Color/image correspondence, no-color/demo fixtures

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Sized products shall require a chosen available size before add; unavailable sizes are disabled. Missing stock rows and selecting an unavailable size for an alert need resolution (G-09).
row.qa_focus: No size, stock 0, missing row, mixed stock

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Detail quantity shall start at one, not decrease below one, clamp to known positive available stock, and disable add/increase when the known limit is reached.
row.qa_focus: 1, stock limit, size change, unknown stock

row.requirement_and_acceptance: In-stock unsized cards shall allow quick-add; sized cards shall send the user to choose size; out-of-stock cards shall display unavailable status and hide add controls.
row.qa_focus: Sized/unsized/out-of-stock and signed-out actions

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Lines shall be identified by product ID + size + color; matching tuples merge quantities and differing options create distinct lines.
row.qa_focus: Same/different options, null/missing color, repeated add

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Drawer shall show image/name/options/quantity/line total; plus/minus updates quantity; a quantity below one or explicit remove deletes the line.
row.qa_focus: Remove at one, variant-specific deletion, total changes

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Request shall contain 1–50 raw item entries and each normalized variant quantity shall be an integer 1–20; duplicate tuples merge and merged quantity above 20 fails.
row.qa_focus: 0/1/50/51 lines, quantity 0/1/20/21/fraction, duplicates

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Server shall fetch current inventory and use database price snapshots, ignoring browser-supplied prices/totals; selected size inventory applies when size is sent.
row.qa_focus: Price tampering, stale price, removed product

row.requirement_and_acceptance: A successful transaction shall create one pending order and all lines with quantity, unit price, size/color; decrement inventory and set total to sum of snapshots.
row.qa_focus: Sized/unsized/multi-line transactions, shared color stock

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Insufficient stock at precheck or transaction shall return conflict; transaction failure shall leave no partial order/lines/stock decrement. Competing orders must not oversell.
row.qa_focus: Last unit concurrency, later-line failure, DB failure

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Order service shall reject unsupported size/color and prevent duplicate orders from replay; current validation lacks catalog-option enforcement and idempotency (G-08, G-14).
row.qa_focus: Invalid option, sized item without size, repeated identical POST

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Available alert UI shall accept email for an unavailable item/selected size and save product/email/size/color without customer authentication; invalid email/product shall fail. Specific unavailable-size selection is a UI gap (G-09).
row.qa_focus: Guest, whole-product versus size request, invalid product/email

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Email shall be trimmed/lowercased; duplicate pending product/email/size/color requests shall return already_subscribed; otherwise create one pending record and token.
row.qa_focus: Case, null options, concurrent duplicate uniqueness

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Response/UI shall distinguish saved-with-mail-enabled from saved-with-mail-disabled; absent delivery configuration shall keep pending requests.
row.qa_focus: Mail on/off, missing database, queued response

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Admin positive stock save can trigger up to 100 pending product requests, filtering by size when supplied, and mark successful sends notified; true stock/transition checks, retry scheduling and robust deduplication are incomplete (G-12).
row.qa_focus: Size eligibility, provider failure, repeated/concurrent batches

row.requirement_and_acceptance: GET/POST token unsubscribe shall delete the matching alert and return plain confirmation; malformed token fails, well-formed already-removed token is still successful; public clients cannot directly read the alert table.
row.qa_focus: Valid/repeated/malformed token, privacy/RLS

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Stock view shall expose one row per configured size or one Overall row for unsized products; edits save on field blur through protected stock PATCH.
row.qa_focus: Sized/unsized, blur versus typing, expired cookie

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Stock API shall reject negative/noninteger values; size save shall upsert product/size row and recalculate product stock from all stored size rows.
row.qa_focus: 0/1/4/5, negative/fraction, missing/existing row

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Size/overall inventory shall remain consistent on failures/concurrent saves; current multi-request stock update is not atomic and size membership is not enforced (G-18).
row.qa_focus: Failure between writes, concurrent edits, unsupported size

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Footer newsletter shall require an email-shaped value, then show preview-only/no-save/no-send feedback. There shall be no implied successful real subscription.
row.qa_focus: Invalid/valid email, no network subscription/write

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Footer shall link all categories, favorites, privacy, terms and maintainer GitHub; information pages shall provide return-home navigation.
row.qa_focus: All destinations and external link attributes

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Checkout/privacy/terms shall explain demo limits and stored demo data; generic shipping/returns copy and confirmation wording need alignment (G-22).
row.qa_focus: Content consistency and fictional data guidance

row.requirement_and_acceptance: Requirements CI shall run the checked-in synchronization regression tests. Build and lint shall reject stale derived documentation, unreviewed tracked website source, or a mismatched review snapshot/log. Synchronization preserves manual fields and archives changed/retired rows; affected executed results become Needs retest. An explicit descriptive review is required to approve source changes and shall never mark tests Passed.
row.qa_focus: Missing snapshot, source drift, CSV manual evidence, retired IDs, repeated sync, review assertions
